# v2.3.5

## Fixes
- FOV / ADS sensitivity: settings in the launcher now correctly take effect after the game rewrites them at startup (same sync fix previously applied to team colors).

## Features
- Skip intro: new option in Feature Settings > Misc tab to bypass the warning screen and intro video on game start. Enabled by default.
- Disable main menu frame cap: new option in Feature Settings > Misc tab to uncap FPS while on the main menu screen. Enabled by default.
- Import / Export configs: new Import / Export button in the main window — share your full config or individual features with others via a zip bundle.
